parent_objective: audit M2274 support gaps and choose next non-ranking scenario/task-quality route
supersedes: controller ranking from incomplete role support

public_gates: M2275 must audit M2274 completeness and guardrails
M2275 must decide whether role/scenario-axis gaps justify scenario task-family generation design
M2275 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M2274 support audit into a next route decision
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2274 artifacts are incomplete
stop if audit routes directly to training
stop if audit ignores missing role/scenario-axis support
fallback_plan: route to scenario family generation design if gaps are real
route to metric instrumentation if roles are sufficient but metrics are missing
route to artifact repair if inputs are incomplete

training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2274 support audit result and choose next route
allowed_updates: M2275 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by audit
next_stage_criteria: M2274 completeness and guardrails are audited
support gaps are accepted or rejected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2275 audits support artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2275; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If support gaps are real, route to scenario family generation before any self-ID claim.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits support gaps before any new scenario generation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit scenario task-family generation design
must_synthesize_if: M2275 would route directly to training
M2275 finds broad support gaps but no generation design path

hypothesis: M2274 support gaps justify scenario task-family generation design before new training or ranking.
success_criteria: M2274 result_class and guardrails are audited
a non-ranking follow-up route is selected
guardrails remain false for ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims
failure_criteria: M2275 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2275 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2275 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual artifact audit of runs/m2274_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_quality_support_audit/summary.json and support tables

decision_rule: M2275 passes if it audits M2274 and selects a non-ranking follow-up route.
